Historic conversion · lifestyle boutique · restaurant-forward urban

Compare this format if you are underwriting a historic urban conversion in CALA: design narrative, F&B complexity, and lifestyle operating load—not select-service reflag economics.

Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands (Seven Mile Beach)

New-build resort · 266 rooms · spa and signature F&B

Kimpton Seafire on Seven Mile Beach is Kimpton’s flagship Caribbean resort—opened 2016 as Grand Cayman’s first major new resort in more than a decade, with spa, multiple dining venues, and IHG One Rewards at scale.

Benchmark for large-key CALA resort lifestyle: public-space investment, spa operations, and multi-outlet F&B—not limited-service or economy reflag paths.

Seven Mile Beach competes on leisure retail and fee stack—use local comps and operator track record before you assume Seafire-scale economics on a smaller parcel.
